testcase.name: Scenario: Apply and restore the mini wheel size: tmp/obk-wheel-size-3943-source/features/application/viewport-navigation-wheel/viewport-navigation-wheel.feature:141:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Apply and restore the mini wheel size ✔ Given the Mini View Object Wheel is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the mini wheel size preference is Normal ✔ When the user opens wheel options and chooses Extra Large for mini wheel size ✔ And the user clicks OK ✔ Then the options dialog closes ✔ And the mini wheel appears larger than before ✔ When the user reopens wheel options ✔ Then the mini wheel size field displays Extra Large ✔ When the user chooses Normal for mini wheel size and clicks OK ✔ Then the mini wheel returns to its earlier apparent size ✔ When the user chooses Full Navigation Wheel from the wheel menu ✔ And the user presses Escape ✔ Then the wheel closes and the status area displays Ready
